+title: Move missing-docs-swift to the toolchain swift format
+---
+## What
+
+`builtin/validators/code-hygiene/rules/missing-docs-swift.md` runs `swiftlint`. The Swift toolchain decides the same bullet with its own rule `AllPublicDeclarationsHaveDocumentation`. Move this rule to `swift format lint`, and remove one more Homebrew dependency.
+
+Files to change:
+- `builtin/validators/code-hygiene/rules/missing-docs-swift.md`
+- `builtin/validators/code-hygiene/fixtures/missing-docs-swift.fail.swift.tmpl`
+- `builtin/validators/code-hygiene/fixtures/missing-docs-swift.pass.swift.tmpl`
+- the matching test file under `crates/swissarmyhammer-validators/src/review/tool_rules/tests/shipped/`
+
+Measured on the Swift 6.4 toolchain, over a public struct with no documentation:
+
+```
+Dirty.swift:3:1: error: [AllPublicDeclarationsHaveDocumentation] add a documentation comment for 'Probe'
+Dirty.swift:4:5: error: [AllPublicDeclarationsHaveDocumentation] add a documentation comment for 'items '
+```
+
+`AllPublicDeclarationsHaveDocumentation` is OFF in the default configuration. The written configuration must make it ON, and must make every other rule OFF, because this gate decides only the documentation bullet.
+
+Use the same script shape the task "Move idioms-swift to the toolchain swift format" writes: a temporary `.swift-format` configuration file, one `swift format lint --strict` run for each file, and one JSON finding for each output line. Do that task first.
+
+Do NOT make ON `ValidateDocumentationComments` or `BeginDocumentationCommentWithOneLineSummary` in this task. Those two decide the bullets of `builtin/validators/swift/rules/doc-parameter-naming.md`, which is a different requirement and a different owner.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The script names `swift format` and names `swiftlint` nowhere.
+- [ ] `doctor.check_command` tests the toolchain. The rule needs Homebrew no longer.
+- [ ] The configuration makes ON only `AllPublicDeclarationsHaveDocumentation`.
+- [ ] The failing fixture gives one finding for each declaration with no documentation, at exit 0.
+- [ ] The passing fixture gives 0 findings, exit 0 and 0 bytes on stderr.
+- [ ] The rule body records the measurement, and states which Swift version gives the rule.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Update the acceptance tests of this rule for the new tool and the new message shape.
+- [ ] Write a test that holds the configuration to making ON only `AllPublicDeclarationsHaveDocumentation`. A rule added to the configuration fails the test by name.
+- [ ] Write a test that holds the gate silent on a file where every public declaration has a documentation comment.
+- [ ] Run `cargo test -p swissarmyhammer-validators missing_docs`. Every test passes.
+- [ ] Run `sah doctor`. The rule reports as healthy, and its fixture pair passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write the failing tests first, then write the code that makes them pass. #swift
\ No newline at end of file
